rules_tested: R1: Admin vs. Application Message Classification during Resend
R2: Contiguous Admin Message Coalescing into SequenceReset-GapFill (35=4, 123=Y, 36=last_admin+1)
expert_rationale: Stored messages 4..9 contain admin messages at 4 (35=0), 6 (35=1), and 7 (35=0), and application orders (35=D) at 5, 8, and 9. Admin messages must never be resent verbatim; contiguous admin messages 6 and 7 must coalesce into a single SequenceReset-GapFill (35=4, 123=Y, 34=6, 36=8).
